title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-p19p: test_hash.c orphan file at repo root
description:
## Issue

`test_hash.c` was added at the repository root in commit 7caf5b3.

### Problem

- No SPDX license header (required for all files in this project)
- No build integration (no Makefile, CMakeLists.txt, or Cargo.toml reference it)
- Appears to be a one-off debug/scratch file accidentally committed
- Tests `lichen_hash_32` with hardcoded expected values but is not part of any test suite

### Expected

Either integrate into the proper test infrastructure (Zephyr test or equivalent) with license headers and build integration, or remove the file.
